channelTitle: Stomach feeling off? Grandma June's gentle go-to
hook: Stomach feeling unsettled and nothing sounds good? Grandma June's gentle fix.
remedy: An old-fashioned kitchen remedy for a queasy day: a few spoonfuls of plain applesauce. Generations reached for it as the gentle thing when the stomach felt off.
steps: Take plain unsweetened applesauce, not the spiced kind
Eat a few small spoonfuls at room temperature
Wait an hour before trying anything heavier
cta: What was your family's gentle go-to for an off stomach? Comment below for Grandma June
